Rombo AI Platform for Industrial NMR Analysis

In oil & gas, petrochemicals, chemicals and energy, material quality determines how a product will perform. Yet accurate characterization is still slow and hard to scale:

  • A full characterization often requires several reference methods, instruments and specialists
  • Results can take days, while operational decisions can't wait
  • Manual, repetitive workflows introduce variability between analysts and sites
  • Reports remain isolated snapshots instead of a comparable history

In industrial contexts, while process indicators may look stable to QC operators, the chemical change and material shift may already be happening. The problem is not the measurement — it's the lack of early signals, with critical deviations leading to significant production loss.

Rombo AI Platform

Rombo AI Platform brings NMR acquisition and domain-specific AI into industrial workflows, with traceability, reproducibility, local validation, and expert review as first-class requirements.

Build a consistent, explainable material state baseline. Detect drifts, chemical regime changes, and early signs of irreversibility.

One platform, two modules

NMR AI Analyzer and AutoML Framework are modules of Rombo AI Platform. Each production workflow is validated on relevant instruments, samples, and operating conditions.

Module 1 — NMR AI Analyzer

Module 1

NMR AI Analyzer

Discover the unique AI + Spectroscopy power. NMR AI Analyzer is designed for industrial labs where traceability and comparability matter. The software controls the NMR data acquisition, AI model integration, report generation, and integration with enterprise systems.

Key Features:

Raw Spectra Ingestion & Deep Learning Analysis
Ingest raw benchtop NMR spectra and analyze spectral patterns consistently across campaigns.
Multi-Property Prediction
Configure the physico-chemical properties you need and get them from a single scan.
Regime Change & Drift Detection
Timely detect chemical regime changes and gradual drifts in material behavior over time.
15-Minute Full Report Generation
Go from sample to multi-property report in about 15 minutes, removing lab bottlenecks and accelerating industrial decisions.

Module 2 — AutoML Framework

Module 2

AutoML Framework

Our AI expertise, at your service. As an optional module, we enable R&D teams to build their own internal ML modules and custom pipelines, while retaining 100% Intellectual Property and utilizing their own data. It supports model selection, validation, and comparison — grounded in experimental datasets.

  • Feature selection and pipeline comparison
  • Training and validation with agreed metrics
  • Performance comparison across approaches & models
  • Support for adapting to new datasets (data quality + validation criteria)
Built on ROSE, 500+ assays & 3 patents
Every AutoML pipeline starts from ROSE, our openly published NMR foundation model pre-trained on millions of ¹H NMR spectra, combined with 3 patents on neural-network spectral processing and proprietary models fine-tuned on 500+ full crude oil assays (including a 24-crude reference library across 6 global regions). Your custom models start from a rich spectral representation instead of from scratch, needing as few as ~10 calibration samples.
How it's delivered
Best for technical and R&D teams. We start with a short conversation to assess fit, data or sample requirements, and validation criteria before defining a structured pilot.

Technology

Built on an NMR foundation model & 3 patents

Rombo AI Platform is powered by ROSE, our spectral foundation model trained on millions of NMR spectra, fine-tuned on 500+ proprietary full crude oil assays, and backed by 3 patents covering neural-network spectral processing, acquisition protocols, and calibration transfer. The entire platform runs on-premise on a local workstation so your data never leaves the plant.

How we work

Talk through your analytical challenge.

We first assess the analytical problem, available data or samples, and target decision. If there is a strong fit, we define a focused pilot with clear objectives, success metrics, and a roadmap to scale.

1. Share the challenge

What sample type, workflow, and decision do you need to improve?

2. Review the fit

We review technical fit, data quality, sample requirements, and validation constraints.

3. Define the pilot

If the fit is strong, we propose objectives, metrics, timeline, and expected outputs.

4. Plan scale-up

After validation, we support integration and production-readiness.

What you get first: a clear view of fit, sample needs, validation criteria, and a recommendation for the next step.
